title: Lissity propagates through powers of an ideal
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $B$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $J\subset B$ an ideal. Use constant coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $K\in D^-(\mathcal C,\underline B)$, meaning its cohomology vanishes in sufficiently high degrees. Suppose every cohomology sheaf of $K\otimes_B^L B/J$ is locally constant with finitely generated $B/J$-module stalks (locally a constant module sheaf). Then every cohomology sheaf of $K\otimes_B^L B/J^m$ is locally constant with finitely generated $B/J^m$-module stalks for every $m\geq1$. If $J^m=0$, this conclusion applies to $K$ itself.
